reasoning: On the season so far the 76ers are the stronger team; with home court the 76ers start about 6 points better, in a game of about 224 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Nets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the 76ers.
Bottom line: the 76ers win 64 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 197 and 246 total points.

analyst.text: This is Philadelphia's second night of a back-to-back, and neither Joel Embiid nor LeBron James has played both ends of one this season, with Tacko Fall the only healthy center. Brooklyn are openly listening to offers; Michael Porter Jr., on an expiring deal, missed Saturday for personal reasons and Noah Clowney started in his place. The angle leans slightly towards the Nets.
